answer: In each epoch, an agent bonds stake to an RLN identity and evaluates a committed polynomial whose secret share authorizes rate-limited messages. Semaphore membership proofs conceal the signer while nullifiers prevent replay. If that identity emits duplicate messages, conflicting evaluations reveal Shamir shares sufficient to reconstruct its private key, triggering instantaneous, protocol-enforced collateral slashing. The raven, crystal, and meadow labels remain distinct test inputs, not identities.
